column1: # What `cargo xtask corpus verify --strict` expects of the corpus besides a
# PASS (spec/harness.md "corpus", "Expected results"), read from here by
# every verify and by the full gate's corpus steps. One line per target and
# test, every LLVM major of the test; no wildcard and no directory rows:
# A refused row: hod declines the module with that name in strict mode; the
# results count as expected. Another name, or hod building the test, fails
# the run (the row is then stale: delete it). An undefined row: the program
# is undefined on that target; both compilers still build it in strict mode
# (a refusal or build failure fails), its run is not compared.
# AArch64 has no row: every corpus test is built and equal to llc.
